headline: Sudanese residents launch clean up drive as rubbish overwhelms Khartoum streets
label: NEWS
caption:
Piles of rubbish and toxic smoke threaten health across war torn Khartoum 🗑️

According to Al Jazeera, returning residents in Sudan have launched clean up drives as waste collection trucks fail to arrive and neighbourhoods turn into open dumps. The ongoing conflict between the Sudanese Armed Forces and the Rapid Support Forces has left basic infrastructure and public services ruined.

Public health specialist Dr Al Fatih Mahmoud warned that repeated exposure to toxic fumes from burning rubbish poses long term health risks and creates favourable conditions for disease transmission. Residents have appealed to the authorities to provide waste collection trucks and containers in residential areas.
